why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Four lines are about CLI behaviour (`--shout Ada`, `Ada --shout`, plain `Ada`, and `--shout` with no name). Each has a "run" proof that runs the CLI locally and checks exact stdout bytes with `od -c`, the exit status, and stderr. All of this can be done at the PR head and gives one answer. The docs line is a "read" of docs/index.md at the PR head, not of the published site. The npm test line uses `npm test` plus a grep of test/greet.test.js, which is also local. Only "outcome" mentions the published site ("after the next push to main"), not any expect line. The non_goals state plainly that publishing or checking the live page at o.github.io is out of scope. No expect line needs a release, a deploy or a published page.
